The '''Vintrus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vintrus]].
